# toRi

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of toRi R package is to provide a seamless way to calculate temporal orientation
  indices in R from data obtained from Google Trends or other online platforms.

## Installation

You can install the development version of toRi from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("BISONS-Lab/naturetime-package-tori")
```

## Example

This is a basic example of the usage framework for the toRi package:

```{r example}
library(toRi)
## Load example dataset
data(sample_data)

## Check data fit for calculating temporal orientation indices
checkData(sample_data)

# Edit data names for check fit
names(sample_data) <- c("focus_year", "present", "past", "future")

## Check data again
checkData(sample_data)

## calculate temporal orientation indices from sample data
test_toi <- calculateTOI(sample_data)

## extract additional data from Google trends based on year or concept searches
#year_sv_2020 <- getYearSearches(focus.year = 2020, search.horizon = 1, api.key = "YOURAPIKEY")
#concept_sv_2020 <- getYearSearches(focus.year = 2020, api.key = "YOURAPIKEY")
```

Examples of the use of each function available in this package are provided can be consulted by calling the help function as shown:

```{r help}
# Get function help
?getYearSearches
?getConceptSearches
?checkData
?calculateTOI
```
